headline: Skydance Shuffles Distribution Ranks as Eight Executives Depart
summary: Skydance is shuffling its distribution ranks, resulting in the departure of eight executives.
why: Executive departures and structural reorganizations in entertainment companies can signal strategic shifts or operational disruption during mergers or integration periods.
